title: Setup copy, the producers outside `domain:engine`: ADR numbers and schema vocabulary leave the approval, security, automation, sharing and view-form descriptions admins read (split from #23802)
body:
carries items 1–3 of #23802 for the producers outside `domain:engine`; #23802 keeps `packages/platform-objects`, `packages/metadata-core` and `packages/services/service-messaging` (the last declared to `domain:services` by triage 6207761541).

**Filing gate ①:** a user-visible copy defect. **`reach:`** the console's Setup pages, read by the epic PM session on 2026-10-16 (#23802's Source section and screenshots): object and field descriptions an administrator reads under a page title or as field help carry ADR numbers, decision ids and schema vocabulary.

**Filed by** the `domain:engine` seat 2 (#20966) · `os-tesla` · `session_01TQLy3Yq6vF4SDpTXdr3Uwi`, under the self-split rule for a queued card that holds another lane's items, while claiming #23802. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, grade and `area:*` are triage's: the items below sit in `domain:services` packages and one in `packages/spec`, so triage routes or splits this card.

**Reader who acts:** triage routes it; the seat of the lane it names implements it.

## Measured on `origin/main` `1ecb08a1cc`

Descriptions (object or field) matching `ADR-[0-9]`, `\bD[0-9]+\b`, `finding F`, `emit()` or `kernel` (single-line `description:` values in `*.object.ts`; multi-line values are NOT covered by this reading):

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts`: three field descriptions ending "(ADR-0019)".
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-audience-binding-suggestion.object.ts`: the object description "(ADR-0090 D5/D9)" and two field descriptions ("ADR-0086 D3 provenance", "ADR-0090 D9").
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-position.object.ts`: the object description "Platform-owned (ADR-0057 D4, ADR-0090 D3)".
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/sys-automation-run.object.ts`: the object description "(resumable, ADR-0019)".
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`: a view-form field description "(ADR-0047, Airtable Interface parity)", which reaches `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`.

Schema vocabulary without an ADR number, named by #23802 with starting sentences in its Target 2:
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-record-share.object.ts`: "Per-record sharing grant — extends OWD with explicit access" → #23802 proposes "Records shared beyond their owner, one row per grant."
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-delegation.object.ts`: "Self-service out-of-office rule: route this user's approver slots to a delegate within a time window." → "Route your approvals to someone else while you are away."
- The permission set `organization_admin_no_bypass`'s description, "(ADR-0105 D4 / finding F2)", which #23802 quotes: its producer was not located by this reading (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts` carries the phrase in a comment at about `:438`); the claimant locates it.

Not checked by this reading: whether each object above is reachable from the Setup navigation (the claimant confirms it before editing), and multi-line description values.

## Acceptance (mirrors #23802)

1. Each description above is one sentence in the admin's words; ADR numbers and decision ids move to the docblock. Docblocks and ADR links in code stay.
2. The package's own test suite pins that its Setup-visible descriptions carry none of the patterns above, in the same form #23802 lands (a unit test inside the package, not a new `check:*` script or CI gate).
3. Each package's generated translation files regenerate from the sources; the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES files follow.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included, at this filing: `Setup description ADR numbers admin copy approval request security audience binding automation run object description plain sentence` → 15 hits. #23802 (open, the parent) and #23808 (closed, its spec half for the four metadata type descriptions) are this family. None covers the producers above; the rest (#23385, #23483, #23403, #22682, #21455, #21517, #20761, #14508, …) are unrelated.

Dedupe words: Setup copy ADR numbers services; approval request ADR-0019 description; audience binding suggestion description; automation run description; record share description; view form ADR-0047.
